name: Sneeze
overview: Sneeze is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include semi-autonomous, convulsive expulsion of air from the lungs through the nose and mouth. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: From a clinical perspective, a sneeze is a semi-autonomous, convulsive expulsion of air from the lungs through the nose and mouth...
In routine practice, a sneeze expels air forcibly from the mouth and nose in an explosive, spasmodic involuntary action.
Health professionals note that this action allows for mucus to escape through the nasal cavity and saliva to escape from the oral cavity.
Health professionals note that sneezing is possibly linked to sudden exposure to bright light, sudden change (drop) in temperature, breeze of cold air, a particularly full stomach...
From a clinical perspective, because sneezes can spread disease through infectious aerosol droplets, it is recommended to cover one's mouth and nose with the forearm...
